description: Important: osbuild and osbuild-composer security update
Moderate: gstreamer1, gstreamer1-plugins-bad-free, gstreamer1-plugins-ugly-free, and gstreamer1-rtsp-server security update
Moderate: delve and golang security update
Important: yelp and yelp-xsl security update

A flaw was found in Quay. When an organization acts as a proxy cache, and a user or robot pulls an image that hasn't been mirrored yet, they are granted "Admin" permissions on the newly created repository.
